INSERT INTO factor_daily (instrument_id, trade_date, ma5, ma10, ma20, ma60, macd_dif, macd_dea, macd_hist, rsi6, rsi12, rsi24, return_20, return_60, volatility_20, pct_from_52w_high, volume_ratio_5, volume_ratio_20, vol_chg_20, atr_20, amplitude_20, downside_vol_20, pct_from_52w_low, new_high_60, new_high_120, data_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{it.instrumentId}, #{it.tradeDate}, #{it.ma5}, #{it.ma10}, #{it.ma20}, #{it.ma60}, #{it.macdDif}, #{it.macdDea}, #{it.macdHist}, #{it.rsi6}, #{it.rsi12}, #{it.rsi24}, #{it.return20}, #{it.return60}, #{it.volatility20}, #{it.pctFrom52wHigh}, #{it.volumeRatio5}, #{it.volumeRatio20}, #{it.volChg20}, #{it.atr20}, #{it.amplitude20}, #{it.downsideVol20}, #{it.pctFrom52wLow}, #{it.newHigh60}, #{it.newHigh120}, 'ACCEPTED', strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
ON CONFLICT (instrument_id, trade_date) DO UPDATE SET ma5 = excluded.ma5, ma10 = excluded.ma10, ma20 = excluded.ma20, ma60 = excluded.ma60, macd_dif = excluded.macd_dif, macd_dea = excluded.macd_dea, macd_hist = excluded.macd_hist, rsi6 = excluded.rsi6, rsi12 = excluded.rsi12, rsi24 = excluded.rsi24, return_20 = excluded.return_20, return_60 = excluded.return_60, volatility_20 = excluded.volatility_20, pct_from_52w_high = excluded.pct_from_52w_high, volume_ratio_5 = excluded.volume_ratio_5, volume_ratio_20 = excluded.volume_ratio_20, vol_chg_20 = excluded.vol_chg_20, atr_20 = excluded.atr_20, amplitude_20 = excluded.amplitude_20, downside_vol_20 = excluded.downside_vol_20, pct_from_52w_low = excluded.pct_from_52w_low, new_high_60 = excluded.new_high_60, new_high_120 = excluded.new_high_120, data_status = excluded.data_status, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
